mechanism: Two independent fully funded isolated-margin sleeves (BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT), 50/50 initial NAV. BASE-UNIT INVARIANT: q_spot == -q_perp (same quantity of the underlying), never USD-notional equalization. Entry: q = (C - buffer) / (S + P + f_s*S + f_p*P) — the EXACT weighted per-leg fee equation (never the factored (S+P)(1+f_s+f_p) form) — so that spot principal, perp collateral, and both fees plus a 2%-of-sleeve buffer exhaust initial equity exactly. Funding settles at each 8h event on perp notional marked at the perp open, signed EXACTLY (short flow = -q_p * P * r, q_p < 0: receives when r > 0, pays when r < 0; duplicate snapped 8h events fail closed). Perp MTM settles hourly into the isolated collateral account; margin call when account equity falls below 0.5% of short notional terminates the sleeve. Gross law: spot notional + |perp notional| <= 1.0x NAV at every hour; breach repaired by PROPORTIONAL BOTH-LEG reduction (sell spot AND cover the same base units of perp, fees on both legs, pro-rata isolated-account release) preserving the base-unit invariant. Preregistered retarget clocks (24/168/720h) retarget the common base quantity to the entry construction (buffer re-declared), tradING both legs together, then re-target isolated collateral to 1x of short notional: sweep from posted collateral to cash or top up from cash only; shortfalls are cash-bounded and logged, never borrowed. Margin is audited every hour at BOTH the close mark AND the adverse intrahour perp HIGH (conservative: a breach at the adverse edge unwinds immediately at that edge; intrahour recovery may not be exploited).
next_experiment: No variant advances. If the direction is ever revived, a liquidation-hazard re-specification (wider buffers, dynamic notional caps tied to adverse-edge moves) must be registered before any new data access, and the same intrahour audit applied. Otherwise the append-only prospective forward shadow from 2026-08-30 remains the only path.

parameters.canonical_weighted_entry_formula: q = (C - buffer) / (S_open + P_open + f_s*S_open + f_p*P_open)  # EXACT weighted per-leg form matching run.py (NOT (S+P)(1+f_s+f_p))
parameters.canonical_weighted_repair_formula: u = (gross - equity) / ((S + P) - (f_s*S + f_p*P))  # BOTH-leg proportional release, base units
parameters.position_invariant: q_spot == -q_perp in base units at entry, every retarget, and every repair
